scripts.initialize:
set -euo pipefail
bash .agents/setup
pnpm build
(cd apple/FloridaCore && swift build --build-tests)
(cd apple/FloridaKit && swift build --build-tests)
bash .agents/refresh --record

commands.name: swift-core
commands.command: cd apple/FloridaCore && swift build --build-tests && swift test

commands.name: swift-kit
commands.command: cd apple/FloridaKit && swift build --build-tests && swift test
